description:
You are the Operations Manager at Meridian Industrial Supply. The inventory management team has escalated a replenishment crisis: multiple products in the warehouse have fallen to critically low or zero stock levels, and several have no automated reorder rules configured, creating immediate stockout risk. Review the current inventory levels for storable products in the main warehouse, identify which products have insufficient stock with no active minimum stock reorder rule in place, and configure appropriate minimum stock rules for them. Once the rules are set up, run the replenishment scheduler to generate purchase orders for any products already below their minimum threshold. The business requires all critical products to be covered by automated replenishment.

Login: http://localhost:8069 | Username: admin | Password: admin
